name: Wild Courts
worldbuilding: Elven enclaves, fey courts, forest spirits, beast clans, and ancient wilderness kingdoms. Their armies control where Engagements occur, relying on terrain, ambush, and unconventional movement.

factionRule.name: Paths of the Wild
factionRule.effect: Ignore the first 2" of Difficult Terrain during each Move activation; finish moves legally. In addition, while a friendly Unit already benefits from Cover, it gains Cover 1 (additive with other eligible Cover X ranks). The faction bonus does not itself grant Cover or qualify a Unit as being in Cover.

factionCommands.name: Through the Wild
factionCommands.effect: Reposition one friendly Unit from a terrain feature to another suitable terrain feature within Medium. It cannot finish Engaged.

factionCommands.name: Entangling Growth
factionCommands.effect: One visible enemy within Medium suffers Slow 2 or cannot Charge during the current Phase.

factionCommands.name: Fade into the Wilds
factionCommands.effect: After being attacked, one unengaged friendly Unit may Move up to 3".

factionCommands.name: Cull the Flank
factionCommands.effect: Choose one friendly Unit within Short and one of these battlefield-role counters when activating: Anti-Cavalry 4 or Anti-Ranged 4. That Unit gains the selected Anti-tag 4 for its next eligible Attack against a Unit actually bearing the matching tag this Round. Applicable Anti ranks never add; use the highest. This is one CP-powered Command and cannot stack with another friendly Command on the same Attack.

abilities.name: Woodland Stalker
abilities.effect: While this Unit is benefiting from Cover, it gains Concealed and its Longbows improve Hit from 5+ to 4+. This applies to Cover from any eligible source; no natural/artificial terrain distinction. The faction rule’s additional Cover 1 cannot itself create Cover eligibility.

abilities.name: Forest Ambush
abilities.effect: If beginning in Cover, Move up to 2" before declaring a Charge, ending legally.

abilities.name: Thicket Ambush
abilities.effect: If this Unit began its activation in Cover, gain Accurate 1 and Charge 1 on its Charge this Phase.

abilities.name: Mark Prey
abilities.effect: Choose one visible enemy within Medium. Up to two friendly Units within Medium of the Huntmaster gain Accurate 1 on their next Attack against it this Round.

abilities.name: Renewal
abilities.effect: Heal 1 Damage from each of up to two friendly Units within Short.

upgrades.name: Veil of Briars
upgrades.effect: Place a 25mm token within Short Range. Until the beginning of this Unit's next Movement activation, the area within 1" of the token blocks line of sight. The obstruction affects friendly and enemy Units equally. Remove the token when the effect expires.

abilities.name: Guided Hunt
abilities.effect: One Beast, Cavalry, or Monster Unit within Short gains Accurate 1 on its next Attack and ignores Difficult Terrain during its next Move.

optionalUpgrades.name: Specialized Guidance
optionalUpgrades.effect: At list construction choose one existing creature/material Trait tag. Other friendly Units wholly within 3" gain Anti-[that tag] 2. Highest applicable Anti rank only. This is a passive aura, not a free Command; does not benefit its source.

abilities.name: Living Bastion
abilities.effect: Friendly Units immediately behind or adjacent to this Model benefit from Cover against ranged Attacks when physically appropriate.

abilities.name: Canopy Flight
abilities.effect: May Move over terrain and Models but must finish legally.

abilities.name: Sovereign of the Forest
abilities.effect: Friendly Units within Medium ignore movement penalties from natural Difficult Terrain.

abilities.name: Entwined Dominion
abilities.effect: Choose up to two visible enemy Units within Medium. Each suffers Slow 2 and cannot Charge until the end of the Round.

genericUnitsWorthTaking: Shield Infantry, ordinary Longbowmen, Scouts, and Engineers or Medics. The Glade Hunters offer mobility and Concealment, while generic archers can be cheaper or more heavily upgraded for accuracy.
designNotes: v4.2 balance pass: added Briar Stalkers as the faction's Extra Core, a melee ambush-Infiltrating unit reinforcing the terrain/ambush identity rather than patching a weakness. Damage-1 weapons across the faction gained +1 Attack; Damage-2+ weapons kept their Attacks and gained a thematic Anti-[Type] (Anti-Infantry on the Treant Ancient's Great Limbs, Anti-Cavalry on the Queen of Thorns' Living Briars) or an improved Hit (Forest Wurm's Claws 4+ -> 3+).
